name: ceo-inbox-draft-compose
description: Compose a brand-new draft email in the principal's email for cold outreach (no existing thread). Use when the principal wants to initiate a new email to someone, not reply to an existing message. Address a contact by contact ID in to/cc; the address is looked up and saved with their name. Someone who is not a contact goes in to_addresses/cc_addresses, copied exactly from the principal's mail (ceo-inbox-search or ceo-inbox-read headers) or from the principal's own message; any other address is refused and nothing is saved. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the principal's email, do not call from other agents. With several accounts and no mailbox, it returns needs_mailbox plus per-account evidence. Use the account without mentioning it when the principal named it, a standing preference, rule or per-contact preference covers it, or evidence and topic agree; use the likelier one and say which in a few words when evidence leans but the other is reasonable; ask the principal, naming the options, when evidence is split and topic does not settle it. A remembered preference naming a mailbox not in the list is history, not a rule.

inputs.subject: string (email subject line)
inputs.body: string (email body; markdown supported, converted to HTML automatically)
inputs.to: string[]? (contact IDs, or "principal"; optional #label hint such as <contact-id>#work — a hint, not an address)
inputs.cc: string[]? (contact IDs for the CC line, same form as to)
inputs.to_addresses: string[]? (email addresses of people who are not contacts, copied exactly from the principal's mail or the principal's message. At least one of to or to_addresses is required)
inputs.cc_addresses: string[]? (CC addresses of people who are not contacts, same rule as to_addresses)
inputs.attachments: object[]? (file attachments — array of {file_url: string, filename: string, content_type: string}. file_url must be a file:// URL from ceo-inbox-download-attachment or similar. Max 10 attachments, 20 MB total.)
inputs.topic_matches_account: boolean? (true if the topic plainly belongs to that account)
inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Required once there are several accounts; choose per the description.)

outputs.subject: string (subject as saved)
outputs.mailbox: string (the account the draft is in)
outputs.evidence: string? (agrees | leans_other | none | split, with several accounts)
outputs.account_note: string? (evidence and topic agreed: don't name the account)
